payload.title: Directory content source: nested directories become nested slugs
payload.description: DirectoryContentSource (project --from-dir) takes the first directory as the section and the file stem as the slug, so content/examples/getting-started/hello-world.md is /examples/hello-world/. Tactus-web needs /examples/<chapter>/<example>/. Make the slug the path under the section (segments slugified, joined by /); opt in per row via nestedSlug so CMS sites keep today's behaviour. Needed by PPY-ef5843.
